children: PARTNER ODDIFACT SAYS FDA CONSULTATIONS ALLOW MABIONCD20 TO BE USED AS FIRST-LINE THERAPY FOR ITP
CLINICAL TRIAL OBSERVATION PERIOD FOR MABIONCD20 CAN BE SHORTENED TO 24 WEEKS FROM 52 WEEKS
SHORTENED OBSERVATION PERIOD EXPECTED TO ACCELERATE MABIONCD20 DEVELOPMENT, MAY REDUCE COSTS AND PARTICIPANT BURDEN
FINAL PROTOCOL AND ASSESSMENTS TO BE SUBMITTED TO FDA IN DECEMBER 2026
